solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Originally Hebrew heaps could be worked out in these measures

indicators.note: letters that can be worked out are being solved into another order
originally points to the start of the word it governs, so only its opening letter is kept

explanation.surface: A note that old Hebrew piles were reckoned in some ancient unit.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the plural of EPHAH; the Hebrew connection in the surface is genuine.
explanation.definitionFit: An ephah is an ancient Hebrew dry measure of capacity, roughly a bushel.

clue.text: Talk drinking port in religious office

indicators.note: something drinking takes another thing inside itself

parts.note: to prate is to talk idly
Rio de Janeiro, a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: Chatter over a glass of port among clergy.
explanation.definitionFit: A priorate is the office or term of a prior, the head of a religious house.

clue.text: English queen maybe the fellow's held to be goddess

indicators.note: the fellow has the other pieces held within him

parts.note: a queen is a female cat

explanation.surface: An English queen, perhaps, is held by some man to be divine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen' points at royalty, but 'maybe' flags an example: a queen is a female cat.
explanation.definitionFit: Hecate is the Greek goddess of witchcraft, crossroads and the night.

clue.text: A hero becoming bitter

parts.note: El Cid, the Spanish national hero

explanation.surface: A champion turning sour.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid can describe a sharp or sour taste or temperament, as bitter does.

clue.text: Criminal investigators certain to nab little monster

indicators.note: to nab is to catch and hold, so one word captures the other

explanation.surface: Detectives are bound to catch a small terror of a child.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sûreté is the French police detective department.

clue.text: City den providing something to eat

parts.note: EC, the postal district of the City of London

explanation.surface: An urban hideaway that also serves food.
explanation.definitionFit: An éclair is a cream-filled choux pastry, a cake to eat.

clue.text: Anomalous yet properly organised mini-illustration

indicators.note: putting letters properly in order means rearranging them

parts.note: a pic is a short form of picture

explanation.surface: An odd little picture that is nevertheless tidily arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Etypic, a rare word, means not conforming to type, hence irregular.

clue.text: My soldiers line up at the front

explanation.surface: An officer's cry for the troops to form a line at the front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' is the exclamation, not the possessive; the line is placed at the front of the soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Lor is a dialect exclamation of surprise, like 'My!' or 'Lord!'.

clue.text: Pole's boy on a rise

indicators.note: in a down entry a rise reads from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A Polish lad climbs a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole's' suggests a Polish person but means of an electrical pole, the anode.
explanation.definitionFit: Anodal means relating to the anode, the positive pole of a cell.

clue.text: More than one in family case pretends son is terrible

definitions.text: More than one in family case

indicators.note: something terrible is in a bad state, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: In a family court dispute, a son is faking badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Respondents are the defending parties in a case such as a divorce petition, a family case.

clue.text: Pa's neurotic about safeguards

indicators.note: about can mean moved around, so the letters are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: Father is anxious over his safety measures.
explanation.definitionFit: Precautions are measures taken in advance to prevent harm, which is what safeguards are.

clue.text: A privateer aboard ship rarely sweats

parts.note: per means a, as in ten pounds a day

indicators.note: someone aboard a vessel is inside it

parts.note: a privateer is a licensed pirate

explanation.surface: A buccaneer on board seldom breaks into a sweat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A' must become PER, not stay a single letter. 'Rarely' belongs to the definition: perspirate is a rare form of perspire.
explanation.definitionFit: To perspirate is an uncommon variant of perspire, meaning to sweat.

clue.text: Timing devices whine audibly and make a rough noise when knocked over

indicators.note: audibly means as heard, so a word is spelt by its sound
a thing knocked over ends up the other way round

parts.note: a snort is a harsh nasal noise

explanation.surface: Clocks that whine and rasp when someone knocks them over.
explanation.definitionFit: A krytron is a cold-cathode gas-filled switching tube used for very precise high-speed timing.

clue.text: I adore travelling around?

indicators.note: letters that are travelling move out of their places

explanation.surface: Someone declares they love life on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: a band's touring crew member might well say this.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadie is a member of a touring band's road crew, always on the move.

clue.text: Old man, one joining political party — so this?

definitions.text: Old man, one joining political party — so this?

parts.note: the Democratic Unionist Party of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A father signs up to a party and so becomes a full member.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: someone joining a party, with dues settled, is this.
explanation.definitionFit: A paid-up member has paid the subscription and so is fully enrolled.

clue.text: Island dismissing leader in very unfriendly manner

indicators.note: dismissing the leader sends the first letter away

explanation.surface: An island sacks its chief in a frosty way.
explanation.definitionFit: Icily means coldly, in a hostile and distant manner.

clue.text: City sailor up to hug his mate?

indicators.note: in a down entry going up means reading from the bottom
to hug is to wrap around something

explanation.surface: A sailor in a city embracing his shipmate.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabat is the capital city of Morocco.

clue.text: Instrument to jam endlessly on "middle" note, leading to fuss

indicators.note: endlessly means without its final letter

parts.note: middle C is the central note on a piano

explanation.surface: A musician jams endlessly on one central note, causing a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: A sticcado is a xylophone-like percussion instrument of wooden bars.

clue.text: What knocks out wild animal — a terrible end in store

indicators.note: things in store are kept inside something else
something terrible is in bad shape, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: part of the letters to rearrange
part of the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A beast is felled, a dreadful end awaiting it.
explanation.definitionFit: A deadener is anything that numbs or dulls, as an anaesthetic knocks out sensation.

clue.text: Song from non-Christian having a change of heart

indicators.note: its heart, the central letter, is swapped for a different one

explanation.surface: A heathen converts, singing a hymn.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle G of PAGAN is changed to E; the clue does not say which letter, so the definition must fix it.
explanation.definitionFit: A paean is a song of praise or triumph.

clue.text: To look happy maiden's not showing strain

indicators.note: a letter not showing has been taken out

parts.note: to smile is to look happy
M is the cricket scorer's maiden over

explanation.surface: A girl trying to look cheerful hides her stress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strain' looks like stress but is the verb for filtering.
explanation.definitionFit: Sile is a Scots and dialect verb meaning to strain or filter a liquid.

clue.text: "Cheers!" and "Shame!" said to be unacceptable

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the spelling follows the sound

explanation.surface: Mixed cries of thanks and disgust are deemed out of order.
explanation.walkthrough: TA BOO spoken is taboo; TABU is the variant spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabu is a variant of taboo, meaning forbidden or socially unacceptable.

clue.text: Broads — fantastic to get on surface

indicators.note: something fantastic is fanciful and unreal, so the letters are reimagined

explanation.surface: Wonderful women heading up to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To adsorb is to hold molecules of a gas or liquid as a film on a surface.

clue.text: Any number in a sport provided with special tag

indicators.note: in places one item inside another

parts.note: n is the mathematician's symbol for any number

explanation.surface: Players in a sport are each given a special label.
explanation.definitionFit: An agname is an extra name or nickname added to a person's name, a special tag.

clue.text: Ultimately you kill grub that's destroyed cereal

indicators.note: destroyed means wrecked, so the letters are broken up and rebuilt
ultimately means at the end, so the last letters are kept

explanation.surface: An instruction to kill the larvae that have ruined the grain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grub' and 'cereal' both suggest food, but the grub is a larva and only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Bulgur is cracked wheat, a cereal grain used in Middle Eastern cooking.

clue.text: Put forward allegation, quietly take initiative

parts.note: p, piano, is quiet in music
to lead is to take the initiative

explanation.surface: Make a claim, then calmly take charge.
explanation.definitionFit: To plead is to put forward a case or allegation in court.

clue.text: Go on river? Stop going on it

explanation.surface: Keep going along a river, or stop moving on it?
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'on it' puts the stop above the river.
explanation.definitionFit: To endure is to last or carry on, as to go on does.

clue.text: Refute old Socialist with terrible rage outside university

parts.note: red, a dated term for a socialist

indicators.note: outside means wrapped around something else
terrible suggests something in a mess, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: An old leftie disproves an argument in a furious campus row.
explanation.definitionFit: Redargue is an archaic word for to disprove or confute.

clue.text: Word to describe friars in capital city

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the state capital of Texas

explanation.surface: A term for monks found in a capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Austin is a contraction of Augustinian, used of the friars; it is also the capital of Texas.

clue.text: Heavy person with trumpet at entrance to thieves' hideout

parts.note: a lur is a long Bronze Age Scandinavian trumpet

explanation.surface: A burly man blowing a horn at the door of a robbers' lair.
explanation.definitionFit: A lurden is an archaic word for a dull, sluggish, heavy-witted person.

clue.text: Gush as before in the bar

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an obsolete verb for flowing or gushing

explanation.surface: Pouring a drink like before in the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As before' marks the first sense as archaic.
explanation.definitionFit: Rail once meant to flow or gush; a rail is also a horizontal bar.

clue.text: Ill-gotten gains brought back — lots — in workers' containers

indicators.note: brought back means returned, read from the other end

parts.note: bags of something means lots of it

explanation.surface: Stolen goods returned in great numbers, stashed in tradesmen's kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Toolbags are bags in which workmen carry their tools.

clue.text: Youngster's pulse when upset

indicators.note: upset means overturned, so in a down entry it reads the other way

parts.note: dal is split lentils or other pulses

explanation.surface: A child's heartbeat when distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pulse' suggests a heartbeat but is the edible seed.
explanation.definitionFit: A lad is a boy, a youngster.

clue.text: Writs for accused people up in arms ere being released

indicators.note: letters being released are let loose to form a new order

explanation.surface: Legal documents for defendants who were angry before being freed.
explanation.definitionFit: A praemunire is a writ summoning a person accused of asserting papal jurisdiction in England.

clue.text: Master treasurer's message to member who owes him money

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to overcome or bring under control

definitions.text: treasurer's message to member who owes him money
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as two words: the subscription is owing

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is cryptic: split the answer into SUB DUE, a reminder that a membership fee is owed.
explanation.definitionFit: To subdue is to conquer or overpower, as to master is.

clue.text: Bosses in terrible flurries if wrongly ignored

indicators.note: terrible implies disorder, so the remaining letters are jumbled
letters ignored are left out, and wrongly says they need not be in order

explanation.surface: Managers caught up in dreadful commotion if mistakenly overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: The F and I leave FLURRIES in a different order from 'if', which is what 'wrongly' allows.
explanation.definitionFit: Rulers are those who govern or control, as bosses do.
